carriedObservations.D2APLAN-R1-NBO-1: The encoder is fallible: encode(&Control3Root) -> Result<Vec<u8>, EncodeRefusal>, refusing a hello without exactly one offer and an over-bound frame. Its acceptance tests cover the host-sendable messages; the decoder, schema and matrix tests cover all sixteen types. The unit's review checks that invalid constructed output is refused. The accepted plan bytes are not edited.
carriedObservations.D2APLAN-R1-NBO-2: LD-D2A-6's bound-plus-four limit is the raw stream-frame buffer only. The reader's arena, container stack, decoded strings and validation copies are further frame-bounded storage, linear in the frame, with nonrecursive drop, debug and equality; no total parser-memory figure is claimed.

rootAssessment: Lead assent to the D2a plan r1 (M3-D r5 item 9): control_protocol.rs as a pure codec deciding each frame exactly as CC v5's retained reference does, against an explicit sixteen-member context with the 65,536 policy in the production constructor; a nonrecursive arena reader keeping long integer lexemes and unpaired surrogates for the UTF-8 walk; the product schema control-v3 evaluated by a closed interpreter of exactly its keywords; the reference's precedence with its two repairs and two recorded corpus readings; direction stopping in the session driver; the vendored corpus replayed byte for byte (482 checks natively, the two architecture-side source pins in the lane); the confirm-only select tuple; one dependency edge (opensip-contracts) and no serde on wire bytes.
